title: Build the Mermaid rendering mod with a bundled renderer
description: Add hooks/register.tsx, a bundled renderer/render.mjs built from beautiful-mermaid, and a vendored mermaid.js for the browser view, per the design in opum-doc docs/reference/operator-questions-skill-design.md at opum-doc origin/main 1312f0c, section Changes this needs in plain-english-styles item 8 and the Rendering the diagrams section. It renders Unicode in the terminal and Svg on desktop, VS Code and mobile, with a local HTML fallback. Built and proved on the terminal and the desktop app.

acceptanceCriteria.text: hooks/register.tsx installs a ui.render hook on the AssistantMessage site and renderer/render.mjs is committed so a git install needs no npm install
A vendored mermaid.js ships for the browser view and loads under strict security with a no-network Content-Security-Policy
A supported diagram draws in place and an unsupported type shows its source plus an Open diagram button
A streaming unclosed fence stays as source until the closing backticks arrive
A diagram wider than bodyColumns falls back to the browser view, never to wrapped art
With neither bun nor node on PATH the mod keeps the source and shows a line naming what is missing
ctrl+o still shows the stored source
The bundled helper ships the licence texts: beautiful-mermaid and mermaid under MIT, ELK.js under EPL-2.0
